title: Beat 227 - Oracle
description: A woman in a patched military jacket and neck device sits inside a cracked glass booth filled with water, holding up a glowing green object while looking upward. The flooded room contains a vintage film projector casting a beam, scattered photographs, pill bottles, a rotary phone, and a large broken doorway revealing a surreal landscape with a lone figure walking toward a fiery sunset.
prompt: A woman in a worn military jacket with patches and a metal neck collar sits inside a shattered glass phone booth filled with water, reaching up with a glowing green object in her palm, her face filled with desperate hope. The room is flooded with reflective water, littered with floating photographs, pill bottles and a rotary phone. A large vintage film projector mounted on the wall casts a bright beam of light. Through a massive broken wall opening is a surreal apocalyptic landscape with a lone figure walking toward a burning sunset sky, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed surreal scene.
